name: Dogs Going To Heaven
overview: Scripture acknowledges that both man and beast share life and breath from God, who holds the soul of every living thing in His hand, emphasizing His sovereign care over all creation (Job 12:10; Psalms 36:6). While man has no inherent preeminence over beasts in terms of mortality, the Bible highlights the righteous man's responsibility to care tenderly for his animals (Proverbs 12:10). Though the covenant God establishes with humanity is distinct and central (Genesis 9:9), the Scriptures recognize the value and preservation of animals, inviting reflection on their place within God's created order (Job 12:7; Ecclesiastes 3:19).
